params.prompt: Create a production-ready 2D cel-shaded fighting-game special animation, 5 seconds, portrait 9:16. Use the supplied image strictly as the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference, NOT as the framing or background. Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, costume, body proportions, original costume markings, shoes and identifying accessories. Recompose from the very FIRST frame as a locked-camera FULL-BODY shot centered on a perfectly uniform flat RGB(0,255,255) #00FFFF background. Character starts at only 58 percent of canvas height. All anatomy, BOTH HANDS, BOTH FEET, props and all effects must remain fully visible inside x=12–88 percent and y=10–90 percent for EVERY frame. Outer 10 percent border is entirely empty pure cyan. No zoom, pan, tilt, tracking, camera shake, cuts, close-ups, offscreen movement, clipping, extra people, morphing, photorealism or 3D. No floor, horizon, scenery, backdrop shadows, gradients, fog, smoke covering the backing or lighting change. Bold ink outlines; preserve character colors, avoid cyan/turquoise VFX because cyan is removed by the game compositor. No captions, move names, new lettering, logos, crowns or title cards. Sound: synchronized short whooshes, prop/action sounds and one impact only; no music, speech or narrator. Timing: 0–0.4 calm opening pose, 0.4–1.2 readable windup, 1.2–2.4 one action and impact, 2.4–3.5 recovery, 3.5–5 hold a complete full-body finisher. Keep the camera completely static and the entire silhouette small enough to fit during the widest pose. Special: The First Lesson. The bespectacled instructor retains his swept-back hair, white rolled-sleeve shirt, dark tailored vest and trousers, emerald tie, orange suspenders, dark boxing gloves and brown shoes. Include one compact leather training bag as in the reference, with its complete short chain and top ring visible wholly inside the safe area, never extending to the top border. He makes a compact guarded parry, gives the bag a crisp short jab marked by a small gold impact ring, then raises the opposite glove in a confident teaching gesture with a brief gold ribbon. The bag shifts only slightly. No giant foreshortened fist, no perspective push-in; both shoes and both gloves remain visible. Remove the reference's illustrated impact lettering; animate only clean effects.
